name: Sauron, Dino Devotee — "It's a green Dinosaur with base power and toughness 5/5" goes to the target
notes: Memory: project_im_a_doctor_pronoun_subject_2026-10-14. The second mode, 'Put a saurian counter on another target creature. It's a green Dinosaur with base power and toughness 5/5 for as long as it has a saurian counter on it.', produced nothing: the 'It's' subject ran back over the counter sentence. A bare 'it / they' now takes the earlier 'target …' phrase. The site does not place the counter, so it is added by hand; without it the condition is false.
